decisions.reason: As a capital-intensive and strategically visible telecom connectivity service that was still promoted prominently after launch, management is likely to justify past investment and interpret any weaker traction as temporary rather than exit quickly.

Although less publicly prominent than Product C, the firm has already invested in this portal-linked voice service and, under escalation of commitment, is more likely to retain it for now than admit a failed launch unless performance problems become unmistakable.
